script:
-- =========================================================
-- Murderers vs Sheriff | AIMLOCK + FIXED ROLE ESP
-- Android / Delta Executor SAFE
-- FULL SCRIPT | NO SNIPPETS
-- =========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ======================= SETTINGS =======================
local AIM_ENABLED = false
local FOV_VALUE = 50
local SNAP_STRENGTH = 0.75

-- ======================= GUI ============================
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
gui.Name = "MVSAimGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local main = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
main.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45,0.35)
main.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.275,0.325)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,0.2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Aimlock + ESP"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
toggle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.25)
toggle.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8,0.2)
toggle.Text = "Aimlock : OFF"
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.TextScaled = true
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

local sliderBG = Instance.new("Frame", main)
sliderBG.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.55)
sliderBG.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8,0.08)
sliderBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
sliderBG.BorderSizePixel = 0

local sliderFill = Instance.new("Frame", sliderBG)
sliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,100,255)
sliderFill.BorderSizePixel = 0

local sliderBtn = Instance.new("Frame", sliderBG)
sliderBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.05,1)
sliderBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
sliderBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
sliderBtn.Active = true

local valueText = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
valueText.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.65)
valueText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8,0.15)
valueText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
valueText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
valueText.TextScaled = true
valueText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

-- ======================= FOV CIRCLE ======================
local circle = Drawing.new("Circle")
circle.Visible = true
circle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120,120,255)
circle.Thickness = 2
circle.NumSides = 64
circle.Filled = false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    circle.Position = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    circle.Radius = 120 + (FOV_VALUE * 1.5)
end)

-- ======================= GUI LOGIC =======================
local draggingSlider = false

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AIM_ENABLED = not AIM_ENABLED
    toggle.Text = AIM_ENABLED and "Aimlock : ON" or "Aimlock : OFF"
end)

sliderBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingSlider = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingSlider = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if draggingSlider and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local x = math.clamp(
            (i.Position.X - sliderBG.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBG.AbsoluteSize.X,
            0,1
        )
        sliderFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x,1)
        sliderBtn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x - 0.025,0)
        FOV_VALUE = math.floor(x * 100)
        valueText.Text = "FOV PRIORITY : "..FOV_VALUE
    end
end)

-- ======================= ESP CORE (FIXED) =======================
local espCache = {}

local function clearESP(player)
    if espCache[player] then
        espCache[player]:Destroy()
        espCache[player] = nil
    end
end

local function updateESP(player)
    if player == LP then return end
    if not player.Character then return end

    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
        clearESP(player)
        return
    end

    local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not tool then
        clearESP(player)
        return
    end

    local role
    local lname = tool.Name:lower()
    if lname:find("knife") then
        role = "murderer"
    elseif lname:find("gun") then
        role = "sheriff"
    else
        clearESP(player)
        return
    end

    if espCache[player] then return end

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Adornee = char
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0

    if role == "murderer" then
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50)
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
    else
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(60,120,255)
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,80,255)
    end

    hl.Parent = char
    espCache[player] = hl
end

local function watchPlayer(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.5)
        updateESP(player)

        char.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait()
            updateESP(player)
        end)

        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        hum.Died:Connect(function()
            clearESP(player)
        end)
    end)

    if player.Character then
        updateESP(player)
    end
end

for _,p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(p)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearESP)

-- ======================= AIMLOCK =======================
local function wallCheck(pos, target)
    local rp = RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character, target}
    rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    return not workspace:Raycast(Camera.CFrame.Position, pos - Camera.CFrame.Position, rp)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not AIM_ENABLED then return end
    if not LP.Character then return end

    local best, bestScore

    for _,p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Team ~= LP.Team and p.Character then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                local pos, vis = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                if vis and wallCheck(root.Position, p.Character) then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X,pos.Y) - Camera.ViewportSize/2).Magnitude
                    local score = (FOV_VALUE/100) * -dist
                    if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
                        bestScore = score
                        best = root
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if best then
        local cf = Camera.CFrame
        Camera.CFrame = cf:Lerp(CFrame.new(cf.Position, best.Position), SNAP_STRENGTH)
    end
end)
